notes.manas-2010:p0658:b001:l001: Continues the shared-sheepfold oath on p657:l042. The meals, gains and faith sequence is preserved line by line.
notes.manas-2010:p0658:b001:l003: Ыймандаш sharing faith in death, potentially including last religious duties; no full funeral rite invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0658:b001:l004: Keng-Kol and Talas retained as places; жылгын is tamarisk.
notes.manas-2010:p0658:b001:l009: Forty prospective blue-maned companions retained; no reconciliation with later slain forty companions on p677.
notes.manas-2010:p0658:b001:l015: Көй кашка laudatory peerless/bold ones, not a person’s name.
notes.manas-2010:p0658:b001:l016: Drawing and sheathing swords retained as the selection context; no sword-fighting test invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0658:b001:l018: Олуязаада literally saint-born; the inserted epithet refers to Bakay, whose name follows.
notes.manas-2010:p0658:b001:l024: Чураган may emphasize running/shouting; retained as hurried noisy clumsiness with qualified shouting.
notes.manas-2010:p0658:b001:l026: Бейпайлуу terrible/troublesome rather than merely poor. Wretched qualifies the enemy’s dreadful nature.
notes.manas-2010:p0658:b001:l030: English keeps the fleeing/abandoning sequence across three lines; no new group introduced.
notes.manas-2010:p0658:b001:l035: Дүмпөкү interpreted ignorant/foolish; local glossary p1837:l002–003 gives foolish/half-witted and coarse/quarrelsome senses.
notes.manas-2010:p0658:b001:l038: Келеме шарып read as holy Quran in the physical grasping oath context. Local glossary p1839:l007 келеме шарап = Quran/sacred words. Revised from declaration of faith; exact form not normalized in source.
notes.manas-2010:p0658:b001:l040: Twig cutting is explicitly present; no additional ritual mechanics supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0658:b001:l042: Hands dipped in blood is explicit oath action; local glossary p1839:l020 confirms this oath expression.
notes.manas-2010:p0659:b001:l004: Байдын уулу provisionally Bay’s son in Bakay’s genealogy; бай also means wealthy man. Proper-name interpretation remains qualified rather than claiming new biographical certainty.
notes.manas-2010:p0659:b001:l005: Argyn Khan’s Azhybay understood patronymically as son; no modern lineage reconstruction.
notes.manas-2010:p0659:b001:l007: Leader of the forty companions apposition precedes Bakay’s speech; retained without resolving every preceding appositional attachment.
notes.manas-2010:p0659:b001:l009: Оён rendered noble, not a new name or unglossed rank.
notes.manas-2010:p0659:b001:l011: Миң дилде a thousand gold coins; not converted to modern currency.
notes.manas-2010:p0659:b001:l016: Previous summer retained alongside theft this autumn on p662:l006.
notes.manas-2010:p0659:b001:l019: Салбырын long hunting expedition, not a place-name; Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/с/.
notes.manas-2010:p0659:b001:l021: Akkelte is the named living/supernatural gun; the literal living epithet retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0659:b001:l023: Салык stored goods/cache, not tax. Yudakhin and 1969 explanatory dictionary storage senses at https://el-sozduk.kg/салык/ and /са/. No raised scaffold inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0659:b001:l025: Utter ruin is Bakay’s idiom for the loss; not a report of his death.
notes.manas-2010:p0659:b001:l028: Эсил кандын provisionally dear khan’s, not an otherwise unidentified Khan Esil.
notes.manas-2010:p0659:b001:l030: Келте is the shortened gun designation alongside Akkelte; short gun keeps the source shortening and weapon context.
notes.manas-2010:p0659:b001:l035: Алдай-соолай coax/cajole, with possible deceitful force; not a promise of immediately peaceful resolution.
notes.manas-2010:p0659:b001:l041: Seven forefathers and infidel insult retained exactly, without endorsement or a historical religious claim.
notes.manas-2010:p0660:b001:l002: Үзгүлтүк broken/interrupted terrain; exact landscape term uncertain, retained as broken steppe spur.
notes.manas-2010:p0660:b001:l007: Shared lodging/night companionship preserves the intimacy formula, without additional relationship claim.
notes.manas-2010:p0660:b001:l010: Saint-like elder is a self-description despite explicit age thirty-five below.
notes.manas-2010:p0660:b001:l012: Spear’s beauty is interpreted as skill at leveling it; grammatical epithet compressed.
notes.manas-2010:p0660:b001:l013: Thirty-five is explicitly Bakay’s stated age, retained despite old/elder epithets.
notes.manas-2010:p0660:b001:l015: Kartküröng is the named horse; no silent substitution for other chestnut horse names.
notes.manas-2010:p0660:b001:l017: Palm-sized letter retained. No missing text of this letter invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0660:b001:l021: Өлүп кел literally die and return; go and die renders the directional exhortation without logical harmonization of later safe-return commands.
notes.manas-2010:p0660:b001:l029: Openings/gaps refer contextually to fortress access; source wording retained without adding tactics.
notes.manas-2010:p0660:b001:l035: Envoys are not killed is the character’s customary maxim, not a modern legal claim; contradictory death warnings remain.
notes.manas-2010:p0660:b001:l037: Бурку means kind/different, local p1836:l016. Seventy tongues retained; no exact languages supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0660:b001:l040: Dark ridge/support metaphor and repeated бел are retained; exact кара кыр phrase remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0661:b001:l003: My twin is an affectionate equality metaphor, not literal twin genealogy.
notes.manas-2010:p0661:b001:l012: Command to die rather than endure humiliation retained without sanitizing.
notes.manas-2010:p0661:b001:l017: Two-day deadline retained in both lines, distinct from the later six-month postponement.
notes.manas-2010:p0661:b001:l023: Returning through mutual slaughter is intentionally paradoxical beside dying together; no correction to victorious return.
notes.manas-2010:p0661:b001:l031: Былчылдашып wet-thudding blows, a sound image; no invented anatomical detail.
notes.manas-2010:p0661:b001:l032: Hairy-mouthed is the source adversary epithet; not a zoological or ethnic fact asserted by translator.
notes.manas-2010:p0661:b001:l036: Салыкка калган атагы visibly says name/fame left in storage. Literal awkwardness retained rather than emending атагы to a presumed weapon noun.
notes.manas-2010:p0661:b001:l040: Кулжуңдашып provisionally proud/bulky movement showing strength; source negative retained in oath condition.
notes.manas-2010:p0662:b001:l003: Кулжуңдашып proud show of bodily strength, qualified; not a named person.
notes.manas-2010:p0662:b001:l006: This autumn explicitly retained; previous summer is hunting departure context.
notes.manas-2010:p0662:b001:l016: Курама болот joined/composite steel; no modern metallurgical specification invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0662:b001:l019: Алмабаш is an epic gun type, apple-headed gun, not a new character or independently named second weapon. Yudakhin and 1969/2015 explanatory dictionaries https://el-sozduk.kg/алма/. Revised from bare transliteration. Ашкере outstanding is contextual.
notes.manas-2010:p0662:b001:l021: Sixty days without failure retained; not treated as a technical guarantee.
notes.manas-2010:p0662:b001:l026: Кылымдуу мал great/world’s livestock wealth; no exact value assigned.
notes.manas-2010:p0662:b001:l027: Azhy is the source shortened form of Azhybay, not a different person.
notes.manas-2010:p0662:b001:l028: Driving our lives after it preserves the pursuit/self-sacrifice image.
notes.manas-2010:p0662:b001:l031: Silk matchcord and gold strap retained literally.
notes.manas-2010:p0662:b001:l032: A thousand years retained as hyperbole, not changed to a lifetime.
notes.manas-2010:p0662:b001:l034: Six lions/youngest repeated with Manas; no roster added.
notes.manas-2010:p0662:b001:l041: Санап thinking/recounting here, not counting multiple Akkeltes.
notes.manas-2010:p0662:b001:l042: Burning inside and liver embers preserve bodily lament image.
notes.manas-2010:p0663:b001:l006: Окустан visibly differs from кокустан in next line; both chance formulas retained without collapsing repetition.
notes.manas-2010:p0663:b001:l013: Feet against the wall and trumpet-playing in next line are images of complacent triumph after deceiving the envoy; exact idiomatic force qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0663:b001:l016: Олоң usually a saddle girth/strap. Strap is a provisional gun-context extension, no barrel or stock silently substituted. https://el-sozduk.kg/kolo-9/.
notes.manas-2010:p0663:b001:l019: Manas’s name written on Akkelte precedes delivery to him; supernatural destined ownership retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0663:b001:l021: Worth Beijing is the stated hyperbolic valuation; not an economic equivalence.
notes.manas-2010:p0663:b001:l025: Жаман ат bad name/disgrace, not bad horse.
notes.manas-2010:p0663:b001:l026: Ар белгиси each mark may be defective for another formula; retained without added identifying features.
notes.manas-2010:p0663:b001:l030: Кежилдеше disputing/bickering preserved despite instruction to speak amicably.
notes.manas-2010:p0663:b001:l032: Gathering bravery on the brow is a bodily courage image, not literal equipment.
notes.manas-2010:p0664:b001:l014: Жаздыгыңды ала жат take your pillow: death-taking-an-enemy-with-you idiom, retained as death-pillow rather than literal bedding.
notes.manas-2010:p0664:b001:l018: Hands held behind the back retained as posture.
notes.manas-2010:p0664:b001:l019: Курган/түгөнгүр formulaic narrator epithets can be affectionate or disparaging; formidable uses their emphatic tone in this praise context, not literal ruin.
notes.manas-2010:p0664:b001:l021: Онжоңдогон visibly printed; prancing/lurching gait interpretation qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0664:b001:l025: Көпчүк saddle cushion/pad, not additional luggage invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0664:b001:l031: The pronoun scope can shift from saddlebags to wrapped weapons; English keeps description suspended until five objects at l038.
notes.manas-2010:p0664:b001:l034: Була fine fiber/thread material, precise textile uncertain; not assigned a named imported cloth.
notes.manas-2010:p0664:b001:l038: Five objects from the bag plus Zulpukor already Manas’s account for six blades; both five and six retained without insertion into verse.
notes.manas-2010:p0665:b001:l001: Кылды in compressed кылычтын кылды мыктысы is irregular; very finest of swords retains discernible praise, raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0665:b001:l003: Oykuma treated as the named blade given to Bakay in explicit distribution context; no separate person.
notes.manas-2010:p0665:b001:l006: Ач албарс printed separately here and Ачалбарс joined on p666. Standardized Achalbars as the entrusted sword’s designation; literally hungry keen steel. Local glossary албарс = sharp steel/weapon.
notes.manas-2010:p0665:b001:l012: Source switches between addressing you and third-person when they come; preserved in nested quotation.
notes.manas-2010:p0665:b001:l018: Terror/presence of forty men, number retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0665:b001:l019: Кызырканып visibly printed; fierce excitement provisionally follows кызыркан- anger/rousing, not patron Kydyr’s name.
notes.manas-2010:p0665:b001:l022: Watching the blade causes death in the source supernatural image; not replaced by being struck.
notes.manas-2010:p0665:b001:l023: Blood-filled weapons refusing their sheaths repeats earlier gift description; all repeated lines retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0665:b001:l028: Singular sword used collectively/distributively for two gifts; English plural clarified locally, source raw retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0665:b001:l035: Аманат жан life entrusted by God; not an extra physical gift.
notes.manas-2010:p0665:b001:l039: All six names inscribed retained; only Manas and Bakay named in preceding line, no invented other four.
notes.manas-2010:p0665:b001:l040: Шайман equipment/resources, with strength failing in same line; no specific broken mechanism supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0665:b001:l042: Кайманадан provisionally carelessly/unawares; loss warning continues next page.
notes.manas-2010:p0666:b001:l003: One of six explicitly given to Azhybay; exact numbers preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0666:b001:l010: Achalbars standardized to joined spelling; same blade as p665:l006.
notes.manas-2010:p0666:b001:l023: Slackening the horse’s mouth means releasing the rein restraint; retains the mouth image.
notes.manas-2010:p0666:b001:l025: Кара туман described as dark mist city; could be toponymic Kara-Tuman, but not confidently a separately named place.
notes.manas-2010:p0666:b001:l028: Broad jaw/wide tongue is eloquence praise, not defect.
notes.manas-2010:p0666:b001:l031: Баашалуу provisionally royal/ruler-bearing, likely пааша relation; no invented ruler name.
notes.manas-2010:p0666:b001:l034: House- and mountain-sized maces retained hyperbole.
notes.manas-2010:p0666:b001:l037: Бакчы means gardener, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/бакчы/. Revised from generic attendants; despite odd court placement, no silent substitution of бакшы/shaman.
notes.manas-2010:p0666:b001:l042: Бекери literally empty/in vain; empty khan-title retained despite flourishing court. Possible defective expected бекери/бекери reading requires review.
notes.manas-2010:p0667:b001:l001: Eighty retainers retained and split forty right/forty left in l004–005.
notes.manas-2010:p0667:b001:l007: Оолжутуп pampering/making languid, context of being propped up like a sick man; qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0667:b001:l014: Envoy’s plural we retained before first-person singular army boast.
notes.manas-2010:p0667:b001:l017: Ат бороюн whole earth per local glossary p1834:l022; not tiring a horse.
notes.manas-2010:p0667:b001:l019: Four surrounding sides paired with four corners, not four repeated circuits.
notes.manas-2010:p0667:b001:l023: Horse outpaces shots while coat resists penetration; distinction retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0667:b001:l029: Eight san retained as epic multitude units without exact conversion. This is Azhybay’s boast, not an independently verified army size.
notes.manas-2010:p0667:b001:l031: Born wandering in Altay preserves exile/dispersion setting.
notes.manas-2010:p0667:b001:l032: Kakan-Chin and Chin-Machin source geographical formula retained without modern border reconstruction.
notes.manas-2010:p0667:b001:l039: From the land-roaming envoy is an awkward source case sequence; no silently reconstructed subject or missing line.
notes.manas-2010:p0667:b001:l040: Керүү grassy upland slope, dictionary sense established in prior lexical work; no fortress/temple rank confused with it.
notes.manas-2010:p0667:b001:l041: Баатыр can address Kerke or identify the caching hero; vocative Hero is provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0668:b001:l005: Opening the cache is contextual object of ачып; source only states his champion opened/took it.
notes.manas-2010:p0668:b001:l012: Worth the whole world is the source scope of the dispute/weapon praise, not modern valuation.
notes.manas-2010:p0668:b001:l022: Repeated requests and formula without quarrelling are all retained, including l024.
notes.manas-2010:p0668:b001:l026: Forearm-thick twisted gold strap preserved, however impractical; not silently reduced to ordinary cord.
notes.manas-2010:p0668:b001:l030: Дүмөк доо grievous lasting claim, no exact law or court invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0668:b001:l034: Соруу drain/suck dry retains threatened destruction image.
notes.manas-2010:p0668:b001:l039: Each worth a thousand retained as explicit warrior comparison.
notes.manas-2010:p0669:b001:l003: Only the undying/surviving remain is literal tautology retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0669:b001:l006: Куурай dry/weed stalk, pliant ripening image retained; no specific plant species assigned.
notes.manas-2010:p0669:b001:l007: Мыйзамдын гүлү autumn airborne gossamer, not law or literal flower. Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/myyzam-6/ gives the exact two-line formula.
notes.manas-2010:p0669:b001:l008: Full six months retained with seasonal image.
notes.manas-2010:p0669:b001:l012: Unknown speech and one-eyed soldiers belong to envoy’s terrifying description, not narrator-certified roster.
notes.manas-2010:p0669:b001:l015: Керик rhinoceros and бил elephant are animal words, not proper names; source forms retained in extraction.
notes.manas-2010:p0669:b001:l025: Water/poison and cap/head formulas deliberately recur; no abridgment.
notes.manas-2010:p0669:b001:l027: Foolishness is stated of Manas by his envoy; not softened into wisdom.
notes.manas-2010:p0669:b001:l029: Чалпоо uncontrolled/rough behavior, violent recklessness in burning-quarrellers context; nuance qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0669:b001:l031: Godlessness/infidel nature retained as a character description of Manas, despite Muslim affiliation elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p0669:b001:l035: Анткор deceitfulness, not changed into straightforward bravery.
notes.manas-2010:p0670:b001:l003: Сырттан mighty predator/hero epithet, not a newly named person.
notes.manas-2010:p0670:b001:l007: Four livestock kinds retained as formula without supplying a disputed species list.
notes.manas-2010:p0670:b001:l021: Fur caps spinning is source panic image; number can be singular collective.
notes.manas-2010:p0670:b001:l023: Элпек nimble/eager ones interpreted attendants/servants in court; exact noun referent remains implicit.
notes.manas-2010:p0670:b001:l026: Secret counsel inferred from whispering and сыр, not an invented specific plan.
notes.manas-2010:p0670:b001:l027: Ten желдет executioners/armed enforcers retained, no modern policing title.
notes.manas-2010:p0670:b001:l032: Collective preparation and singular khan alternate in source; English transitions correspondingly.
notes.manas-2010:p0670:b001:l037: Бой-бойлоп lamenting/interjection rendered Oh, oh, not a name or untranslated utterance.
notes.manas-2010:p0670:b001:l039: Working mind/thinking thoughts repeated verbatim from l035.
notes.manas-2010:p0670:b001:l042: Wisdom from unseen describes Kerke here too; not reserved for protagonists by translator.
notes.manas-2010:p0671:b001:l002: Шум cunning/deceit, not a named person.
notes.manas-2010:p0671:b001:l009: Sixty lords/scouts as printed; later sixty scouts plus forty lords is not harmonized.
notes.manas-2010:p0671:b001:l015: Keen when striking is retained for the gun; no conversion to a sword or added bayonet.
notes.manas-2010:p0671:b001:l019: Сүрүк delay/respite here; six months repeats throughout bargaining without omission.
notes.manas-2010:p0671:b001:l028: Оён noble, not an unglossed military title.
notes.manas-2010:p0671:b001:l037: This source segment visually runs into l038 on one PDF line; both extracted IDs retained with provisional lineation.
notes.manas-2010:p0671:b001:l039: Too late now is the source temporal excuse, not an independently verified chronology.
notes.manas-2010:p0671:b001:l041: Жортормон roaming raider/scout, not a newly introduced person named Zhortormon.
notes.manas-2010:p0672:b001:l002: Жер ченчи literally land-measurer, here roaming scout/surveyor role; no personal name supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0672:b001:l004: Third-person his words retained despite speech addressing envoy; referent uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0672:b001:l016: Shame of fighting acknowledges dispute in Kerke’s own speech, not narrator judgment.
notes.manas-2010:p0672:b001:l021: Chestnut horse fragment precedes narrative aside about failed request; not fused into failed horse description.
notes.manas-2010:p0672:b001:l025: Kartküröng retained as horse name despite generic chestnut in l021.
notes.manas-2010:p0672:b001:l031: Horse explicitly has wings in source praise; not rationalized away.
notes.manas-2010:p0672:b001:l033: Айта-буйта before a brief utterance, translated as before one could utter a word rather than unexplained syllables.
notes.manas-2010:p0673:b001:l007: Upturned nose and sunken eyes retained as insulting portrait.
notes.manas-2010:p0673:b001:l012: Этек hem/end interpreted matter’s end in quarrel idiom; source image remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0673:b001:l013: Чылбыр чайноо = raging/chewing reins, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/чы/. The caused-us force is contextual; source may instead depict Kerke’s own fury.
notes.manas-2010:p0673:b001:l015: Кеп эмизүү feeding words/empty promises, not literal nursing event.
notes.manas-2010:p0673:b001:l017: Claim growing stale is source accusation about delay; no modern statute of limitations asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0673:b001:l020: God has struck Kerke is a curse-like judgment; no intervening divine event invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0673:b001:l025: Six months to prepare retained as Bakay’s interpretation of deceit.
notes.manas-2010:p0673:b001:l038: Falling to shots and dying in attack retained, not changed into killing opponents only.
notes.manas-2010:p0673:b001:l042: Кызыталак abusive oath, rendered damned with pig, preserving insult rather than a literal divorce event. Dictionary usage https://el-sozduk.kg/кыз/.
notes.manas-2010:p0674:b001:l007: Жеткен жерин literally place reached, provisionally inhabitants made to crawl; exact object attachment uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0674:b001:l009: Төр place of honor, distinguished from төрө lord in previous line.
notes.manas-2010:p0674:b001:l011: Azhybay and Bakay visibly printed as those hearing Bakay; retained, not silently changed to Manas and Azhybay.
notes.manas-2010:p0674:b001:l023: Куюлган spreading/pouring terrain description is compressed and uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0674:b001:l024: Ankle-bone hill, saddlecloth hollow, plow furrow, marmot burrow: all four negative landscape comparisons retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0674:b001:l028: Moon-bright yellow plain and farther edge restored to their own respective source rows during alignment.
notes.manas-2010:p0674:b001:l034: Saddle-back ridge retained after description of level plain; no geography harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p0674:b001:l039: Narration shifts back to Kerke’s actions during envoy’s visit; English tense preserves flashback.
notes.manas-2010:p0675:b001:l002: Ботом my child is Kerke’s exclamation; no actual child brought into scene.
notes.manas-2010:p0675:b001:l004: Single-eyed giants reiterate the envoy’s threat in Kerke’s fears; not confirmed historical beings.
notes.manas-2010:p0675:b001:l014: Like a seer is simile; no assertion of certain clairvoyance.
notes.manas-2010:p0675:b001:l019: Sixty scouts and forty lords retained distinctly, unlike earlier sixty lords/scouts.
notes.manas-2010:p0675:b001:l027: Mares with foals and riding bareback are explicit, not replaced with battle saddles.
notes.manas-2010:p0675:b001:l029: Салмакташып provisionally swaying/throwing weight; exact motion uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0675:b001:l032: Жок эмеге unfamiliar things literally things not there; contextual training interpretation qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0675:b001:l038: Binding sun’s eye is magical clouding; not literal injury to sun.
notes.manas-2010:p0675:b001:l039: Parenthesized two-line description remains verse, not an editorial heading. Жайчы weather-worker per local glossary p1837:l016–017, not a personal name.
notes.manas-2010:p0675:b001:l041: Cloudy day/clear night retained even amid worsening storm; no weather consistency correction.
notes.manas-2010:p0675:b001:l042: Күндүн куюн visibly awkward day/sun + whirlwind. Whirling the day’s weather into turmoil is contextual, superseding an unsupported course reading. No silent source restoration.
notes.manas-2010:p0676:b001:l004: Алты сай six-sided/faceted hail, later seven-sided at l009; numbers and source variation retained, geometric interpretation qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0676:b001:l009: Long display line kept in one English row; seven not normalized to preceding six.
notes.manas-2010:p0676:b001:l011: Ала канчык шыбыргак wind-driven sleet/rain turning snow, https://el-sozduk.kg/шыбыргак/. Not literal spotted bitch or new character.
notes.manas-2010:p0676:b001:l014: Longing for a single look implies obscured visibility; clear supplied contextually.
notes.manas-2010:p0676:b001:l018: Seven days of storm retained despite earlier two-day envoy deadline.
notes.manas-2010:p0676:b001:l022: Gray tulpar in source despite Bakay’s Kartküröng elsewhere; no horse-color harmonization. Once on thigh preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0676:b001:l027: None left unharmed/slaughtered is retained despite two newly obtained companions in next page; no added escape scene.
notes.manas-2010:p0676:b001:l030: Дегенине көндү literal agreed to what was said is grammatically uncertain; having his wish fulfilled is contextual recovery interpretation.
notes.manas-2010:p0676:b001:l031: Очогор gun type/heroic matchlock per local p1842:l007 and https://el-sozduk.kg/очогор/; rendered warrior’s gun, not a person or new gun named Ochogor.

notes.manas-2010:p0676:b001:l033: Ашагандан-машаган = fashioned with utmost skill, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/masha-2/ exact formula. Not names of craftsmen, not eating.

notes.manas-2010:p0677:b001:l019: Мураа inherited share, local p1841:l012; people as destined inheritance is source metaphor, not renamed support without note.
notes.manas-2010:p0677:b001:l021: Singer who sings retains source repetition.
notes.manas-2010:p0677:b001:l031: Inheritance repeated from l019; no abridgment.

notes.manas-2010:p0677:b001:l042: Kydyr-visited head formula continues beyond batch boundary; no invented completion.
